name: screen
description: The real desktop, the whole screen, not a web page: screen_ocr (words with their x,y) or screen_shot (the picture) first, then click, type and press keys at pixel x,y from the top-left.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is on the screen -> discover(path='mcp/screen', enable=true); screen_shot()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|click the OK button -> screen_ocr(); screen_click(x=<x of OK>, y=<y of OK>)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|move the mouse like a person to the checkbox -> screen_cursor_move_human(x=420, y=310)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|type hello and press enter -> screen_type(text='hello'); screen_key(key='Return')
